stories.title: F-103 shutdown splash -- ShutdownSequencer phase-emit hook + architecture.md section 10.6
stories.completionNotes: F-103 shutdown-state PRODUCER side SHIPPED (TDD red->green). ShutdownSequencer (SSOT of shutdown phase) now emits a shutdown-state phase event at each handleOnBattery transition via an OPTIONAL generic phaseEmitFn: grace (T=0, BEFORE smoothing resolves -- splash triggers immediately, animation IS the grace countdown) -> cancelled (smoothing-fail OR late power-return abort) | flushing (bounded pipeline about to run) -> powering_off (before systemctl poweroff; VCELL-floor fast-path emits powering_off with NO flushing -- honest instrument, no flush happened). UNIDIRECTIONAL dependency (spec §6/§481): the phase-string constants (PHASE_GRACE/CANCELLED/FLUSHING/POWERING_OFF + DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_REASON) live in controller.py (sequencer = SSOT of phase); src/pi/splash/shutdown_state_emitter.py IMPORTS them -- the sequencer NEVER imports the splash. A-2 constraints honored: (a) non-blocking best-effort write; (b) emission AFTER each transition is decided; (c) an emit that raises is logged + NEVER blocks shutdown (emitter closure catches + sequencer _emitPhase wraps belt-and-braces). NEW shutdown_state_emitter.py = pinned spec §6 schema (buildShutdownState: phase/tGraceStartedAt/tGraceTotalS/tRemainingS/reason/ts) + makeShutdownPhaseEmitter best-effort atomic writer (reuses ensureStatesDir/writeStateAtomic, no dup). When phaseEmitFn is unwired the sequencer runs the BYTE-IDENTICAL legacy path with NO extra isOnBattery() read (explicit regression guard test). Wired in __main__.py gated on pi.splash.enabled (statesDir from pi.splash.statesDir). A-6 timing invariant added verbatim (spec §469-479) to controller.py module docstring. RULE-10 DoD: specs/architecture.md §10.6.1 documents the hook + phase table + A-2/A-6 + the C-5 shutdown-state-survives-eclipse-obd-stop guarantee; the F-103 subsection forward-ref updated to a cross-ref. C-5 needs NO new units -- US-393 already made eclipse-states-http.service share RuntimeDirectory=eclipse-obd + RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=yes and tmpfiles.d recreates states/ every boot (documented §10.6.1). GATES: pytest tests/pi/splash tests/pi/power = 108 passed/1 skipped (POSIX-perms test skips on Windows); ruff clean on all touched files; __main__ import smoke OK. stories.title: Fix sync_now.py import break -- normalize Pi entry-point to pi.*-on-src convention
stories.completionNotes: sync_now.py import break FIXED + batch-audited the scripts/*.py cluster (TDD red->green). ROOT CAUSE confirmed by operator-runtime repro (python scripts/sync_now.py --dry-run, no PYTHONPATH): the script inserted only repo ROOT on sys.path + imported src.pi.sync -> src.pi.sync.client -> src.pi.obdii.drive_id -> src/pi/obdii/__init__.py:26 bare `from pi.display` -> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pi' (top-level `pi` unimportable because only ROOT, not src/, was on the path). FIX (mirrors src/pi/main.py:46-57 dual-path bootstrap): add src/ to sys.path FIRST (so bare `from pi.display` resolves) + keep ROOT (so transitive `from src.common...` legacy form still resolves); flip the PI imports to the convention (src.pi.data->pi.data, src.pi.sync->pi.sync) per acceptance #1 + [[feedback-path-convention-no-src-prefix]]. CROSS-MODULE IDENTITY GUARD ([[feedback-cross-module-enum-identity]]): kept the common.* imports on the legacy src.common.* form ON PURPOSE -- pi.sync.client raises src.common.errors.handler.ConfigurationError, so main()'s `except ConfigurationError` must catch THAT exact class object; `common.errors.handler` resolves to a DIFFERENT (non-caught) class with no unifying re-export, which would turn the graceful 'Error: API key missing' (exit 1) into an uncaught traceback. Verified: operator `python scripts/sync_now.py --dry-run` now imports cleanly + reports the missing-secret config error gracefully (exit 1, no traceback) on this dev box (no COMPANION_API_KEY); on the Pi with the key set it proceeds to the dry-run delta report. TEST FIDELITY: the pre-existing in-process tests (`from scripts import sync_now`) NEVER caught this because tests/conftest.py:38 seeds src/ onto sys.path for the whole pytest session -- so the bug only manifests under the real bare-`python scripts/...` runtime. Added TestOperatorRuntimeImport (subprocess smoke: fresh interpreter, PYTHONPATH stripped, cwd=repo root, `--help` triggers the full import chain then argparse exits 0; asserts no ModuleNotFoundError + rc==0) to BOTH test files -- the only test that reproduces the operator path. Flipped the two test files' src.pi.* imports -> pi.* in lockstep so test-created PushStatus/PushResult share identity with the fixed script's comparisons (pi.sync.__init__ re-exports from src.pi.sync.client, so identity unifies). BATCH AUDIT (acceptance #3, Rule 5): probed every scripts/*.py entry point via `--help`; SAME bug in scripts/record_drain_test.py (ROOT-only + src.pi.obdii.database/src.pi.power.battery_health -> No module named 'pi') -> FIXED identically (cluster = 2). scripts/backfill_pi_battery_health_log_historical_drains.py has a DIFFERENT failure (No module named 'src' -- NO path bootstrap at all, not the ROOT+src.pi.* pattern) -> OUT OF SCOPE, filed offices/pm/tech_debt/TD-056. Scripts already on the clean pi.*-on-src convention (check_platform, render_*, verify_database) or already inserting both paths (seed_pi_fixture, seed_scenarios, schema_diff) left untouched. GATES: pytest tests/scripts/ = ALL PASS (full cluster, zero regression incl. the 2 new subprocess tests); ruff check on all 4 touched files = clean (ruff --fix reorganized import order after the src.pi->pi flip, scoped to touched files per [[feedback-ruff-scope-discipline]]). DEFERRED-TO-PM: mypy not on dev box (no signature changes, only import-path + sys.path edits); full-suite deferred (slow SMB) -- tests/scripts/ is the in-iteration gate per slow-share carve-out, changes are import-path-only in 2 scripts + their 2 tests. ON-PI per validationMethod (validationCriteria #1): `python scripts/sync_now.py --dry-run` on the Pi with no ModuleNotFoundError -- reproduced equivalently off-Pi (clean-env subprocess) but the real Pi run is the bench gate.
